parts.name: InputOTP
parts.description: A controlled six-digit input with visual slots. Native input attributes and ref target the input; className styles the outer field. Type, numeric input mode and one-time-code autocomplete are fixed.

props.name: hint
props.description: Supporting field guidance, associated with the control.

props.name: error
props.description: Error message. Replaces hint text and marks the field invalid.

props.name: value
props.description: Controlled digits shown in the six slots. Keep application state limited to at most six digits.

props.name: onValueChange
props.description: Called with at most six digits after editing or paste; non-digits are removed.

props.name: required
props.description: Requires a non-empty native control value during form validation.

props.name: readOnly
props.description: Keeps the current value readable and focusable while preventing editing.

props.name: onPaste
props.description: Native paste handler; prevent default to skip built-in digit extraction.

props.name: onFocus
props.description: Called when the native control receives focus.

props.name: onBlur
props.description: Called when the native control loses focus.

props.name: aria-describedby
props.description: IDs of additional descriptive elements; field components merge these with their hint or error ID.

props.name: className
props.description: Additional classes on the outer labelled field wrapper.

props.name: id
props.description: Native control ID. Generated when omitted; the visible label and supporting text use this association.

props.name: ref
props.description: Ref to the component’s documented DOM element.
